missing-effect.message: payment_succeeded: onPaymentSucceeded never calls email.receipt (email.send) when it writes paid.
missing-effect.hint: Call email.send after the write in onPaymentSucceeded, or remove email.receipt from payment_succeeded.effects.

unmapped-effect.message: refund: refundOrder calls stripe.charges.create, a gate no spec effect maps to (not in bindings.effects).
unmapped-effect.hint: Declare the effect on refund and map it to stripe.charges.create in bindings.effects, or remove the call.

missing-transition.message: refund: src/orders/refund.ts#refundOrder never writes status = refunded.
missing-transition.hint: Set status to 'refunded' in refundOrder (or a function it calls), or fix impl.

wrong-state.message: ship: src/admin/orders.ts#shipOrder never writes status = shipped.
wrong-state.hint: Set status to 'shipped' in shipOrder (or a function it calls), or fix impl.

wrong-state.message: ship: shipOrder also writes paid → refunded, but ship only goes to shipped.
wrong-state.hint: Remove the write to refunded, or declare it as its own transition in the spec.

extra-linked-write.message: refund: refundOrder also writes paid → cancelled, but refund only goes to refunded.
extra-linked-write.hint: Remove the write to cancelled, or declare it as its own transition in the spec.

undeclared-state.message: refund: refundOrder also writes paid → archived, but refund only goes to refunded ('archived' is not a state of Order).
undeclared-state.hint: Remove the write to archived, or declare it as its own transition in the spec.

never-guarded.message: checkout: owner (requireOwner) is never called before the write (required by checkout.requires).
never-guarded.hint: Call requireOwner on every path from checkout to the write, before any early return.

extra-from.message: checkout: checkout also writes pending_payment from cancelled, which the spec does not allow (from: draft).
extra-from.hint: Tighten the check before the write to status is 'draft', or add cancelled to checkout.from.

strict-from.message: expire: expireOrder only writes cancelled from pending_payment; the spec also allows draft.
strict-from.hint: Remove draft from expire.from, or let the code accept it.

no-impl.message: checkout: not linked to code (no impl), so it is not checked against the code.
no-impl.hint: Add impl: path/to/file.ts#function to checkout to check it against the code.

no-impl.message: checkout writes draft → pending_payment, which no spec transition declares.
no-impl.hint: Declare this transition in the spec with impl: src/orders/checkout.ts#checkout, or remove the write.
